- 7: UP (line 120); 8: FORWARD (line 122).
- 6: DOWN (line 121); 5: BACKWARD (line 123).

The ship keeps moving while waiting for keyboard input (lines 90-200).
Replay starts the original Searcher.z80 in 48K Fuse at 100% speed, then
sends ENTER, 7, 8, 9, 6 in that order. The replay saves real Fuse frames
after the first two movement keys and after firing and moving down.
Delays are real elapsed seconds, not guaranteed game-frame counts.
